solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Repairing south-east side of building

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for south-east
a wing is a side section projecting from a main building

explanation.surface: A repair job on the south-east side of some building.
explanation.definitionFit: Repairing clothes with needle and thread is a sewing job, so the verb form fits the gerund.

clue.text: Indefinite number act and stick around for confrontation

indicators.note: around signals the stick going round the other pieces

parts.note: a staff is a walking stick or rod
n is used in maths for an indefinite number
to do is to act or perform

explanation.surface: Some people acting and loitering around before a confrontation.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-off is a deadlock or confrontation where neither side will back down.

clue.text: Cover up what Hew is fiddling

indicators.note: fiddling means tinkering or tampering, so the letters of the words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man called Hew is fiddling the books and hiding the evidence.
explanation.definitionFit: A whitewash is an attempt to conceal faults or wrongdoing, a cover-up.

clue.text: Feed person who damaged cutlery tucking into grub

indicators.note: tucking into suggests being inserted, so the person goes inside the word for grub

parts.note: nosh is British slang for food
Uri Geller became famous for supposedly bending spoons by mind power

explanation.surface: Someone who bent the cutlery is eating heartily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucking into' looks like eating, but signals insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: To nourish is to feed, supplying what is needed for growth and health.

clue.text: Messenger nursing temperature, one that's hanging on?

indicators.note: to nurse is to hold close, so the messenger word holds the next piece within it

parts.note: a courier carries messages and parcels

explanation.surface: A messenger with a fever is somehow a hanger-on.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on hangers-on at a royal court: attendants who cling to the monarch for favour.
explanation.definitionFit: Attendants at a royal court were often sycophants clinging on for favour, hence hangers-on.

clue.text: Coherent Euro TV broadcast generally available

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A coherent European television channel available across the board.
explanation.definitionFit: Over-the-counter goods, especially medicines, can be bought freely without prescription.

clue.text: Learn about alien king, one with new depth?

indicators.note: about means surrounding here, so the word for learn goes round the others

parts.note: to read a subject is to study and learn it
ET is the alien in the Spielberg film
R is the abbreviation for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Studying an alien monarch who has found new depth.
explanation.definitionFit: A retread is a tyre given a fresh tread, so it has new tread depth.

clue.text: Toughen up in river

parts.note: the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Hardening oneself by plunging into a cold river.
explanation.definitionFit: To inure is to accustom someone to hardship so they become hardened to it.

clue.text: Dashing without taking care round King's Square?

indicators.note: round signals the careless word going round the others

parts.note: rash means reckless, acting without care
K is the chess abbreviation for king
one, the Roman numeral I, is a square number since one times one is one

explanation.surface: Someone driving recklessly round a square named after a king.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that Square stands for one, a square number.
explanation.definitionFit: Rakish means dashingly jaunty and stylish, with a slightly disreputable air.

clue.text: Being abused detrimental to a scruffy person

indicators.note: abused means misused or mistreated, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mistreatment that harms a vagrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A tatterdemalion is a person in ragged clothes, a ragamuffin.

clue.text: Notice one's given by European university that's so long

parts.note: an ad, short for advertisement, is a public notice
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A notice of departure posted by a European university.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are farewells said on parting; the French word is used in English as a goodbye.

clue.text: Amazed when lorry picks up both of us

indicators.note: a lorry picking up passengers takes them aboard, so the pair of words takes the next piece inside

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
we means the speaker plus one other
a lorry is the British word for a truck

explanation.surface: Amazement when a passing lorry stops to give two people a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: Being struck with awe is a strong form of amazement; the two words are near synonyms.

clue.text: Adviser on what to eat composed ditties

indicators.note: composing arranges material into a new form, so the letters of the following word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nutritionist who also wrote little songs.
explanation.definitionFit: A dietist is an older word for a dietitian, an expert who advises on diet and nutrition.

clue.text: Scholarly articles about universal Greek hero

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the articles go round the next piece

parts.note: theses are long scholarly papers written for a degree
U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal

explanation.surface: Academic papers written about a universal Greek hero.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend he was the Athenian hero who slew the Minotaur in the Cretan labyrinth.

clue.text: The old man putting in earth type of plants suitable for borders providing pleasant environment

indicators.note: putting one thing in another places it inside, so the old man takes the next piece within

parts.note: the old man is slang for one's father
E is the abbreviation for earth in electrical wiring

parts.words: type of plants suitable for borders
parts.note: bedding plants are annuals grown for flower beds and borders

explanation.surface: Dad planting out bedding in the garden borders to make the place pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: To featherbed is to pamper or cosset, giving someone an easy and comfortable situation.

clue.text: A U minder's in order?

indicators.note: putting something in order rearranges it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Asking whether a children's minder is up to scratch.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the film certificate for universal viewing, suitable for children, so a U minder looks after the young.
explanation.definitionFit: A nursemaid is a woman employed to look after young children.

clue.text: I always engaged in your old dishonesty

indicators.note: engaged in means taken inside, so the first pieces go inside the old word for your

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your
ever means always

explanation.surface: Someone confessing a long career of dishonesty in your past.
explanation.definitionFit: Thievery is the act of stealing, a form of dishonesty.

clue.text: Time Rome's chief had to be worried?

definitions.text: Time Rome's chief had to be worried?

indicators.note: worried suggests something agitated and disturbed, so the letters before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: When Caesar, Rome's leader, had cause for alarm.
explanation.walkthrough: Julius Caesar was warned by a soothsayer to beware of 15 March, and was assassinated that day, so the whole clue also describes the date.
explanation.definitionFit: The fifteenth of March in the Roman calendar, the date of Julius Caesar's assassination in 44 BC.

clue.text: Meanwhile outside vacation I should get involved

indicators.note: involved means wrapped up, so the following letter is placed within

parts.note: outside the vacation means during the school or university term, so in term

explanation.surface: Meanwhile, out of the holidays, I ought to join in.
explanation.definitionFit: In the interim means in the meantime, the period between two events.

clue.text: Week I laid in military hospital, sickly

indicators.note: to be laid in is to be put inside, so the pieces go within the hospital

parts.note: MASH is a mobile army surgical hospital

explanation.surface: A patient spending a week in an army hospital, feeling ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Mawkish means sickly sentimental, cloying in feeling.

clue.text: Dirty mark from gross mud generally

indicators.note: from signals the letters taken out of the following run of words

explanation.surface: A dirty stain left by thick mud everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A smudge is a smear or blur of dirt.

clue.text: I landed in target backing irregular troops

indicators.note: in puts the first pieces inside the reversed target
backing means moving in reverse, so the word for target is read backwards

parts.note: an aim is a target or goal
lit is a past tense of alight, to land or settle

explanation.surface: Someone touching down on target and supporting a band of irregular fighters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reads like support for the troops, but it turns the target word around, and 'in' places the landing pieces within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A militia is a body of citizen soldiers rather than professional regulars.

clue.text: Place for parking American luxury car

parts.note: a lot is an American term for a car park

explanation.surface: An American parking lot full of expensive cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Lotus is a British maker of high-end sports cars.

clue.text: Out of the running at this time present

parts.note: now means at the present time
here means present, as when answering a roll call

explanation.surface: Someone who is out of contention at this point, though still present.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor said to be nowhere is far behind and has no chance of winning.

clue.text: Decide to put off working

parts.note: to deter is to discourage or put off
a working is an excavation, such as a mine

explanation.surface: Choosing to postpone working.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine something is to settle or resolve it, the same as deciding.

clue.text: Picture that is providing cover for periodical

indicators.note: a cover wraps around something, so the abbreviation goes round the periodical

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is
mag is short for magazine, a periodical

explanation.surface: A photograph used as the cover of a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness, whether painted, photographed or mental.

clue.text: English people in Orient getting right over neighbouring land

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the word for the Orient

parts.note: the Orient is the East
men can mean people in general

explanation.surface: English settlers in the Far East claiming rights over adjacent land.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, this is a right to cross or use another's land, such as a right of way.

clue.text: Badly made rum — chuck bottles

indicators.note: to bottle something is to enclose it, so the throwing word holds the next piece

parts.note: to shy is to throw or chuck
rum in British slang means odd or strange

explanation.surface: Cheap rum, so throw away the bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: Shoddy goods are poorly made and of inferior quality.
